annotations.title: Add a note to a contact

description: Attach a plain-text note to a contact or company's history (newlines kept, HTML/markdown escaped). Returns { NoteId }. LACRM: CreateNote.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

date_displayed.description: When the note should appear in history, ISO 8601 date-time. Default: now.

name: lacrm_create_note
title: Add a note to a contact
